name: d1-omni
note: Liquid's d1-omni decision model: the LFM2.5-Encoder-350M backbone post-trained to 600M for single-pass typed answers, distinguished from the generative and d1 checkpoints only by the GGUF's lfm2.decision.type=lfm2-d1-omni. Its last two attention layers widen to 16 KV heads where the rest state 8, and their FFN narrows to 4096 where the rest state 4608 — the flat signature fields state each mode, the layer lists the actual geometry. Served text-only: the mmproj ships but the runtime cannot drive its tower yet. No draft: a decision model never decodes, so speculative decode weights would install unused. No tuning list: the encoder kernels are not landed, so a sweep cannot run yet.
